import json,sys,collections
d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
print(json.dumps({
 "file":sys.argv[1],"revision":d.get("revision"),"freeze":d.get("freeze"),
 "entries_count":d.get("entries_count"),"entries_evaluated":d.get("entries_evaluated"),
 "mismatches":d.get("mismatches"),"mismatches_count":d.get("mismatches_count"),
 "frozen_path_changed":d.get("frozen_path_changed"),"met_target":d.get("met_target"),
 "exit_code":d.get("exit_code"),"unevaluable_count":d.get("unevaluable_count"),
 "match_counts":dict(collections.Counter(str(e.get("match")) for e in d.get("entries") or [])),
 "files":dict(collections.Counter(e.get("file") for e in d.get("entries") or [])),
},sort_keys=True))
